summary.name: Resemble AI
summary.one_liner: Resemble AI is an enterprise deepfake detection and watermarking platform that flags AI-generated audio, image, video and text, offered on-prem or in the cloud.
keywords: how to tell if a voice is ai generated
use_cases: Detecting synthetic voices in contact center and phone fraud
Verifying identity during KYC and account onboarding
Checking meetings on Zoom-style platforms for fake faces or voices
Triaging abusive deepfake content for trust and safety teams
Producing court-ready forensic reports on suspect media
Verifying documents and receipts for forgery
summary.what_it_does: Resemble AI offers detection models for audio, image, video and text, built in-house. Its DETECT-World model is listed as the latest release and is described as detecting AI-generated audio, video and images. The platform outputs human-readable explanations for detection scores and includes a Signal feature that alerts users when content matches known fraud patterns without recording. It exposes a single REST API covering all modalities that the page says integrates with SIEM, SOAR and identity platforms. Deployment can be fully containerized on-premises, air-gapped, or with a zero retention mode that deletes media after detection.
notable: Air-gapped, fully containerized on-prem deployment with zero retention mode
Single REST API covering audio, image, video and text detection
Claims deploy in 24 hours via guided installation wizard
Holds GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA-aligned claims
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; enterprise contracts appear to be required
Image and video detection is described as internal with external benchmarks still in progress
Page is mostly marketing; the Resemble AI custom voice creation listing is not described on this page
